Multi-Turn RAG Research

Problems, Solutions & State-of-the-Art (2025-2026)

Status: Active Research — Last updated October 19, 2026 · Based on 40+ papers from ACL 2025, EMNLP 2025, SIGIR 2024/2025, SIGDIAL 2025/2026, SemEval 2026, NeurIPS 2025, ICML 2025, ICML 2024
## Executive Summary This research documents the **five core problems** we encountered in our production multi-turn RAG system (Work Credit RAG Phase 1) and maps each to **2025-2026 state-of-the-art solutions** from top-tier venues (ACL 2025, EMNLP 2025, SIGIR 2024/2025, SIGDIAL 2025/2026, SemEval 2026, NeurIPS 2025, ICML 2025). Our production system serves Persian credit-scoring QA across **4 subspaces** (cheque, facilities_person, facilities_legal, general) with **1123 chunks** over **18 documents**. We ran a **41-turn multi-agent benchmark** (12 multi-turn conversations + 12 single-turn baselines) that revealed critical degradation patterns in multi-turn scenarios.

🔍 Subspace Filtering

Static subspace_map mismatch caused 0-chunk retrieval despite relevant content existing. Fixed: map correction + RRF fusion.

Hit: 0.111 → 0.667 (+499%)
FixedPC-RAGSPLIT-RAG
Details →

❓ Ambiguity Resolution

6/6 scattered queries failed to clarify. Fixed: retrieval-grounded clarification gate + iterative rewrite loop.

Ambiguity: 0.854 → 1.000 (6/6)
FixedRACICR
Details →

🔗 Sticky Context

Context lost after 3-4 generic turns. Fixed: sticky carry + decay after 3 generic turns + semantic segmentation.

Sticky: 0.610 → 0.683
FixedCPPCALMem
Details →

📉 Retrieval Degradation

Filtered retrieval had no fallback. Fixed: RRF fusion (filtered + whole-KB) + broadened retry + GPU acceleration.

Hit: 0.537 → 0.780; Latency 8s → 4.9s
FixedGUIRGPU KB
Details →

🛡️ Hallucination Control

Weak-evidence answers hallucinated. Fixed: coverage+score guard + lexical evidence bypass + per-subspace thresholds.

Hallucination: 0.195 → 0.254 (tradeoff for recall)
ImprovedFaith GuardDUTIR
Details →

⚡ Latency & Scale

CPU KB search dominated (2.3s). Fixed: GPU embed + rerank pool 30 = 100× speedup.

Dense: 2325ms → 19ms (100×)
FixedGPU KBBGE-m3
Details →
